title: blackstonia grandiflora
intro: Blackstonia grandiflora, commonly known as Rosy-petal, is a flowering plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Blackstonia grandiflora include its ability to reduce oxidative stress, modulate immune responses, and exhibit cytotoxic activity against certain cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
